source.name: NHS England - A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions, statistical work area (monthly provider-level CSVs)
source.api: per-financial-year sub-pages (2018-19 through 2026-27) each link 12 monthly provider-level CSVs (~30 KB, 21 columns); pre-2018-19 months are XLS-only; the publisher's CDN serves HTTP 202 with an empty body to datacenter IPs (measured 2026-10-21), so reproduction fetches from this package's build use the coordinator-measured URL set
source.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (NHS England / Crown copyright; attribution carries through). Derived research dataset - not an NHS England official product.
